skills.name: Fraction equivalence and simplification
skills.definition: Use fraction equivalence to find common denominators, scale fractions, or reduce a fractional result to lowest or integer form.

skills.name: Like-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities with a shared denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Mixed and whole number management
skills.definition: Decompose mixed or whole numbers into whole and fractional parts, handle missing fractional parts as 0/d, subtract whole parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrowing across whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Regroup by borrowing one or more wholes as denominator-sized fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
